Research refs 35 and 36 concluded that the indexed corpus documents no pre-symptom disambiguation at the harness, caller, or ML Lab validation layers, but a new iteration of ref 36 opened alongside inquiry 37 to probe whether any granular detail beneath the opaque post-hoc symptom could implicitly discriminate overlapping-column and type-override breach classes. The knowledge index added 53 entries, closing at 1005.

generated_overview: The league is currently bifurcated between two active Cosmo & Wanda phenotypes and two offline Timmy variants. Cosmo & Wanda Top 50 (restarted) leads in realized PnL and average ROI, while its Top 20 twin retains incumbent champion status and official data lineage but trails in performance metrics. Both Timmy configurations remain offline under v3 after failing to monetize theoretical skew across 268 combined trades, with Top 50 showing significantly larger best-trade amplitude than Top 20. The competition has effectively become a live A/B test on pair-universe breadth and exit discipline, with all eyes on whether breadth sustains convexity or if narrower focus can reclaim consistency.
